assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring via mobile cardiac telemetry is indicated
The service correlates cardiac rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms and dizziness
The service directly addresses the clinical need to link the patient's palpitations and dizziness to an underlying arrhythmia
The service is documented in the indication note
